text:
Plenty of agencies sell you one channel and call it marketing. SEO only. Facebook only.

Google finds the people searching right now.
Facebook and Instagram keep your name in front of them until they ring.

Pay for one channel and you get half the job done.

Picture an electrician in Osborne Park. His Google Ads make the phone ring at 10am.

He's up a ladder. It goes to voicemail.

The caller rings the next sparky on the page.

You paid for that call. Answer it, or have someone who will.

I tell every new client the bad news first.

The Google map takes months. Some months your ranking dips. Ads cost money every day they run.

Some owners walk away after hearing that. (Good.)

The ones who stay know what they signed up for. That's who I want to work with.
